title: HSK1 Gate 6 · Western Han
explanationEn: Gate 6: Western Han. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第6关：西汉。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 汉朝的时候，中国人不知道西边有什么。皇帝让一个人去西边看看。他走了很多年才回来。他说：“西边有很多国家，也有很多新东西。”
passageEn: In the Han dynasty, Chinese people did not know what lay to the west. The emperor sent a man to go west and take a look. He travelled for many years before he came back. He said: "There are many countries in the west, and many new things."

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Han dynasty, Chinese people did not know what lay to the west.
comprehension.answer: 汉朝的时候，中国人不知道西边有什么。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: He travelled for many years before he came back.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.explanation: “时候”（shíhou）的意思是“time”，就在上面的短文里。

check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: In the Han dynasty, Chinese people did not know what lay to the west.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
